title: FSF Consistency Context v1
description: Immutable consistency context carried inside step.inputs. Specifies asset references, continuity intent, and generation intent for a shot step. The original shot_spec and asset_spec in step.inputs are never modified; all rc5 consistency information lives exclusively here.

asset_refs.description: Ordered list of asset references applicable to this shot. Order is significant and preserved in the digest.

ref_images.description: Shot-level reference images (not per-asset). Each image is identified by role and content SHA-256. Paths are location hints only and excluded from the digest.

continues_from.description: Continuity declaration. Null means no declared continuity. resolved_sha256 is null at compile time and filled by the executor from the completed upstream artifact.

generation_intent.description: Generation prompt components. base_prompt must equal shot_spec.generation_prompt at compile time. effective_prompt is executor-written and excluded from the digest.

review_required.description: When true, assembly steps are gated on an approved fsf_consistency_review_v1 record bound to this shot's artifact.

asset_id.description: Must reference an asset_spec.asset_id present in the same job.

version.description: Operator-assigned version string for this asset.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical asset digest (covers asset_id, version, source_prompt, kind, constraints, ref_images[].{role,sha256}).

ref_images.description: Per-asset reference images. Role and sha256 are content identity; path is a location hint excluded from the digest.

role.description: Semantic role of this reference image.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the reference image file contents. Content identity — path excluded from digest.

path.description: Location hint for the image file. Not included in any digest.

shot_id.description: ID of the source shot this shot continues from. Must be declared before this shot in the same job.

selection_rule.description: How to resolve the upstream artifact. 'latest_completed': take the most recent completed/reused artifact from the current job+run. 'specific_artifact': use artifact_ref.

artifact_ref.description: Required when selection_rule is 'specific_artifact'. The artifact output ref string from the upstream step.

aspects.description: Which visual/narrative aspects this shot continues from the source.

resolved_sha256.description: Null at compile time. Filled by the executor with the actual upstream artifact SHA-256 before computing the inputs_digest.

base_prompt.description: Must equal shot_spec.generation_prompt at compile time. Source of truth for digest. Never rewritten.

injection_rule_version.description: Version of the prompt-assembly rule used to combine base_prompt and asset_injections. Included in digest.

asset_injections.description: Ordered asset text injections. Each entry records which asset contributed text and what was injected. Included in digest.

effective_prompt.description: Executor-written combined prompt (base_prompt + injections). Set at execution time, NOT at compile time. Excluded from the digest. Cannot be set by external callers.

injected_text.description: The text fragment injected for this asset. Included in digest.
